meta.note: Internal FinRes model. Stop/take fills are intrabar; signal fills use close or next-bar close within the same trading day. H4 is synthetic, resampled from native H1 bars (no native H4 in DB).

kt_break.label: KT-break
kt_break.f: C > Up → long; C < Low → exit/short

kc_revert.label: KC-revert
kc_revert.f: C < Low → long; C > Up → exit/short

kt_mid.label: KT-mid
kt_mid.f: C > Mid → long; C < Mid → exit/short

kc_mid.label: KC-mid
kc_mid.f: C < Mid → long; C > Mid → exit/short

kt_break_slope.label: KT-break + slope
kt_break_slope.f: C > Up and dMid > 0 → long; C < Low and dMid < 0 → exit/short

kc_revert_turn.label: KC-revert + turn
kc_revert_turn.f: C < Low and dMid > 0 → long; C > Up and dMid < 0 → exit/short

kt_expand.label: KT-expand
kt_expand.f: C > Up and dWidth > 0 → long; C < Low and dWidth > 0 → exit/short

kc_squeeze.label: KC-squeeze
kc_squeeze.f: C < Low and dWidth < 0 → long; C > Up and dWidth < 0 → exit/short

commissions.label: 0.03% / side
commissions.note: Prior-study convention: three hundredths of a percent of turnover per side.

commissions.label: 3.00% / side
commissions.note: Literal reading of 3/100 of turnover per side.
